Floor derivation: dividends (~RMB1.75bn/yr) exceed attributable core FCF (~RMB1.45bn) by ~RMB0.3bn/yr, so ~RMB3bn of the pile is distributed over the horizon; the retained ~RMB25bn earns ~2.1% post-tax, worth 0.021/0.095 = 22% of face at the cost of equity -> floor ~30% of face, ceiling 100%. Carried at 65%. Associates (at book) and operating cash are not discounted.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (~2.1%) rounded to the terminal rate; equity CAGR rejected as a forward proxy for a cyclical whose revenue has fallen two years running
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3y CAGR 14.9% is >30% above revenue 3y CAGR 5.9% and FCF 3y CAGR 5.8%: book value compounded on retained earnings plus a declining minority buy-out (FY2024), not on top-line growth. Revenue fell 5.2% in FY2025 and 5.2% in H1-2026, so none of the trailing CAGRs is a usable forward rate.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less P&L interest income; SBC nil). Owner and reported series track each other because the stripped items are small relative to FCF; the larger WMP/deposit income never enters reported OCF (received in investing). Owner FCF: FY2020 5,137.8 (reported 5,349.0 - 211.2), FY2022 3,069.7, FY2023 9,569.9 (a working-capital windfall year), FY2024 3,673.5, FY2025 3,638.7. The 5-year owner-FCF CAGR is negative because FY2020 was itself a working-capital release year. Consolidated owner FCF is pre-NCI; the parent's economic share is roughly 60%.

scenario_narratives.base: China's white-goods market stays flat-to-down as the trade-in subsidy pull-forward unwinds and the property downcycle keeps central/commercial AC soft; the HVAC JV (62% of group profit) defends its >23% multi-split share under direct Hisense Group management after the August 2026 leadership change, but at thinner margins. Overseas (45% of revenue, growing high single digits) offsets China volume but dilutes gross margin, so core EBITDA margin sits at 5.7-6.0%, the five-year mean. Capex normalises after the Thailand/Changsha build-out. The RMB35bn of cash, WMPs and deposits remains intact and accessible, and the ~55% dividend payout (RMB1.265/share, a ~7% yield at the valuation-date price) continues.
scenario_narratives.bull: The H1-2026 miss proves to be the trough: copper eases, the 2026 World Cup sponsorship and local-for-local plants (Monterrey, Thailand) lift overseas share and overseas gross margin recovers toward 15%; heat pumps and data-centre liquid cooling (water chillers +69% in FY2025) become a second growth engine inside the JV; Sanden's RMB6.2bn of new EV thermal-management awards convert to revenue by FY2028-29. Revenue compounds ~4% and core EBITDA margin reaches 6.8% -- still below the FY2023 peak -- and the market closes some of the discount on the cash pile.
scenario_narratives.bear: The domestic price war deepens (Midea/Haier/Gree hold 70%+ of AC volume), subsidies lapse, and the HVAC JV loses share after the division president's resignation; US/EU tariffs hit Chinese-made appliances and Sanden's auto components; copper stays high. Revenue falls two more years and core EBITDA margin settles at 4.5%, below the FY2022 level. The RMB11.5bn of deposits with the captive Hisense Finance Co. and the controlling shareholder's related-party web keep the governance discount on the cash pile permanent. Terminal multiple 10x. Note that even here the net financial assets exceed the market cap, so the bear case is mainly a thesis about trapped capital, not solvency.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Hisense Home Appliances is valued as the sum of (a) the parent's ~60% economic share of a thin-margin, cyclical appliance manufacturer whose profit is concentrated in a 49.2%-owned HVAC JV, and (b) a RMB35bn pile of cash, wealth-management products and bank deposits that is larger than the H-share market capitalisation. The operating flows are stripped of every investment-income line and taxed at a combined 49% (15% cash tax, 40% minority leakage) so the DCF captures only what reaches parent shareholders; the financial assets enter the bridge at carrying value with the minority's claim deducted at NCI book. Core EBITDA margins are held at the five-year mean, not the FY2023-25 peak, and the terminal multiple is capped at 12x for a cyclical. The resulting gap between intrinsic value and price is almost entirely the market's discount on the cash pile (related-party deposits, A/H discount, capital-allocation doubts), not an optimistic view of operations; the bear weight of 30% is how that doubt is carried.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash pile accessibility: RMB11.5bn of deposits with Hisense Finance Co. (controlling-shareholder captive); a permanent governance discount or a forced redeployment into low-return group assets would make the bridge's carrying values too high

Minority leakage is an estimate (40% of core after-tax profit, NCI claim on the pile at book RMB4.2bn); if the JV holds a larger share of the financial assets than assumed, the minority's claim could be ~RMB1bn higher (about RMB0.5-0.7/share)
Core margin is thin (4.7-5.0% EBIT): a 1pp move in EBITDA margin changes attributable NOPAT by ~RMB450m, ~25% of the operating value
China white-goods demand and the property cycle; subsidy phase-out reversed H1-2026 volumes by ~20%
HVAC JV leadership instability after the August 2026 resignation; the JV is 62% of group profit
Tariffs on Chinese-made appliances and Sanden auto components; copper and FX (finance costs swung RMB240m FY2024->FY2025)
The H-share trades ~31% below the A-share; the DCF is in HKD on the H line and that discount may persist indefinitely

sanity_check_fix.trip: scripts/sanity_check.py exit 3: base-case upside 102% with the price in the upper half of its 10-year range (66%); diagnosis list empty -- no peak-earnings, WACC or growth cause identified.
sanity_check_fix.why_the_playbook_levers_do_not_apply: Mid-cycle FCF: base margins (5.7-6.0% core EBITDA) are the five-year mean and FY2026 attributable FCF is below FY2025, so earnings are not extrapolated from a peak. WACC: 9.5% in CNY for an all-equity balance sheet; scenario weights already carry cyclicality and governance, and a premium would charge risk twice while moving IV only ~HK$2-3. Growth: base 10-year revenue CAGR ~1.7% versus a through-cycle (FY2016-25) CAGR of 14%. Exit multiple: already capped at 12x attributable FCF, ~4.3x consolidated terminal EBITDA. None of these is the cause.
sanity_check_fix.actual_cause: The upside is a balance-sheet discount, not an operating assumption: RMB35.5bn of cash, wealth-management products and bank deposits (RMB27.9bn after borrowings and the minority's claim) exceeds the H-share market capitalisation (~RMB25-26bn). Carrying that pile at face assumes a minority H-shareholder can realise it; RMB11.5bn sits with the controlling shareholder's captive Hisense Finance Co., the pile has grown RMB8bn since FY2023 rather than being distributed, and the H-share trades 31% below the A-share for identical cash flows.
sanity_check_fix.fix_applied: Trapped-capital discount of 35% on the non-operating financial assets net of NCI (RMB9,089m, about HK$7.7/share) added as an explicit, auditable equity_bridge line. Face value remains visible in the bridge above it; the discount is the single scenario-independent parameter a reader should flex. Operating drivers, WACC, weights and terminal caps are unchanged.
sanity_check_fix.effect: Base IV HK$43.73 -> HK$36.03; bull 51.70 -> 44.00; bear 35.36 -> 27.66; weighted IV HK$42.81 -> HK$35.11 (upside 98% -> 62%); weighted hurdle entry price HK$35.77 -> HK$28.07. Implied P/B 3.42x -> 2.82x (10-year average 2.03x, maximum 2.80x) and P/Sales 0.68x -> 0.56x (average 0.37x, maximum 0.51x); sanity_check.py now passes. P/B is a weak gauge here because operating book value is negative (negative working capital) and group book is almost entirely the financial pile.
sanity_check_fix.what_would_remove_the_discount: A special dividend, a step-up in payout toward 80%+, a buy-out of the Hitachi JV minority funded from the pile, or repatriation of the Hisense Finance deposits to third-party banks. Each is a reason to restore face value in a future update.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report key-management note (Annual_FY2025.txt:14332): share-based payments RMB1.24m -- immaterial; SBC-zero market, explicit 0% path kept
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in CNY (RMB); H-share quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1721 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on 2026-10-10. Parity check: A-share 000921.SZ RMB26.77 (2026-10-09 close) x 1.1721 = HK$31.38, against which the H-share price at inputs.price_as_of stands at a ~31% discount -- a normal A/H discount, not an FX-direction error. This valuation is of the H-share; the A/H gap is itself a reference point for how far the HK line sits below the mainland price of the same cash flows.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,384,861,171 total A+H shares (H1-2026 interim, line 7280) less 745,907 shares in the repurchase account = 1,384.1m. Held FLAT: no material SBC, no announced issuance. The Metrics.csv figure (~1,367m) is NI/EPS and excludes ~17m shares held by the employee stock ownership plans, which remain economically outstanding, so the filed count is used.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: 10y China Government Bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~7.0% (mature-market 4.5% plus country premium), beta 1.1 -> cost of equity ~9.5%. Borrowings are RMB3.5bn against RMB35bn of financial assets, so the capital structure is effectively all-equity and WACC = cost of equity = 9.5%. Cyclicality, governance (related-party deposits) and the HVAC leadership turnover are priced in the scenario flows and weights, NOT as a WACC premium, and all three scenarios share the same WACC (charge risk once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease payments (RoU depreciation RMB75m + lease interest ~RMB8m, FY2025) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path = 0.10% of revenue; D&A path is EX right-of-use depreciation (1,364 - 75 = 1,289m = 1.47% of FY2025 revenue); lease liabilities (RMB262m) EXCLUDED from total_debt, which is short- plus long-term borrowings only (3,487 + 62 incl. current portion = 3,549 at 30-Jun-2026).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once per flow, once per asset. (1) FLOWS: the Hisense-Hitachi central-AC JV (50.8% minority) earned RMB2,932m of the group's RMB4,734m FY2025 net profit, so the minority's share of CORE operating profit is far above the headline 33%. Calibration: FY2025 core EBIT RMB4,167m (operating profit 5,280 less investment gain 1,032, FV gain 231, interest income 43, plus interest expense 193); core tax ~14%; core NP ~3,419m. Minority profit 1,547m less its ~12% share of the after-tax stripped investment income (~160m) leaves ~1,387m = 40.6% of core NP. The engine's cash_tax_rate_path is therefore a COMBINED rate: 1 - (1-0.15)x(1-0.40) = 49%. Tie-out: 4,167 x 0.51 = 2,125 vs reported attributable NI 3,187 less the parent's ~88% share of after-tax stripped income (~1,156) = 2,031, within 5%. (2) BRIDGE: non-operating financial assets are added at 100%, so the minority's claim on them is deducted as a separate bridge item at NCI book value (RMB4,244m at 30-Jun-2026; the JV's 50.8% share of its RMB6.8bn net assets is RMB3.4bn of that). The JV's net assets are largely financial (its operating working capital is negative), so NCI book is a fair proxy for the minority's claim on the pile; a plausible range is RMB3.4-5.0bn, i.e. +/-RMB0.5/share.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company route; non-US/cyclical adaptations applied -- currency-matched WACC, leases as cost, NCI leakage in the flows, matching-asset rule). H-share of an RMB-reporting Chinese white-goods manufacturer with a dominant 49.2%-owned, fully consolidated HVAC JV. MATCHING-ASSET RULE: investment gains on wealth-management products, time-deposit interest, fair-value gains and share of associates' profit are all stripped from the operating flows (they are not in reported OCF/FCF either; WMP income is received in investing activities), so their source assets go into the bridge: transactional financial assets RMB21,469m, current time deposits RMB4,238m, non-current term deposits RMB4,506m, long-term equity investments (associates, at book) RMB1,941m. `cash` and `net_debt` are kept on the Metrics.csv definition (cash at bank and on hand only, borrowings only) and the rest of the pile is itemised in equity_bridge so each line is auditable. These assets are liquid (short-dated bank WMPs and deposits) but RMB11.5bn of the deposits sit with the controlling shareholder's captive Hisense Finance Co. -- a related-party concentration the market visibly discounts: at the valuation-date price the H-share market cap (~RMB25-26bn) is BELOW the net financial assets after NCI (~RMB27.7bn), i.e. the market ascribes zero or negative value to a core business earning ~RMB2.0bn/yr attributable. That governance discount is carried in the 30% bear weight, not by haircutting the assets. Working capital capture 0: the business runs negative operating working capital (notes payable RMB13.9bn), so growth releases cash and contraction absorbs it; 0 is the conservative neutral setting. Buybacks: ~RMB20m of shares repurchased in FY2025 (745,907 shares) -- a token programme; the flat count is a modelling convention the company has not had to fund because SBC is nil. Mid-cycle: core EBITDA margin history FY2021 ~4.6%, FY2022 ~5.2%, FY2023 ~6.5%, FY2024 6.2%, FY2025 6.3%, FY2026E ~5.8% from the H1 run-rate; the base holds 5.7-6.0%, i.e. the 5-year mean, not the FY2023-25 peak. Terminal cap 12x (cyclical durable-goods manufacturer; bull 14x, bear 10x). SANITY FIX 2026-10-12: a 35% trapped-capital discount on the non-operating financial assets (net of NCI) is carried as the last equity_bridge line; see valuation_philosophy.sanity_check_fix.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -4.3%: H1 actual -5.2%, H2 assumed -3% on an easier comparison (H2-2025 was already weak). FY2027 flat as domestic subsidy pull-forward unwinds and overseas (+) offsets China (-). FY2028-31 2.5-3.0%: overseas localisation (Thailand, Changsha, Monterrey) and heat-pump/data-centre cooling offset a structurally flat China white-goods market; then 2.5% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: Core EBITDA (ex investment/FV/interest income) 5.8% FY2026E from the H1 run-rate (H1 6.8%, H2 seasonally ~4.6%), dipping to 5.7% in FY2027 as overseas mix (11-13% GM) dilutes the domestic (28-30% GM) book, then recovering to the 6.0% five-year mean as cost programmes and premiumisation catch up. Never returns to the FY2023 peak of ~6.5%.
base.tax_rationale: Combined 49% = 15% cash tax (high-tech preferential rate plus R&D super-deduction; FY2025 core ~14%, FY2021-22 ~20%) then 40% minority leakage on the after-tax core profit (see inputs.nci_treatment). Held flat: the JV's share of group core profit has been stable at ~60% for three years.
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 capex RMB2,114m (2.4%) was elevated by the Thailand and Changsha industrial parks; H1-2026 ran 1.7%. 1.9% for two years while Thailand completes, tapering to 1.6%, slightly above ex-RoU D&A of 1.47% for growth capex abroad.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: H1-2026 was the first revenue-and-profit double decline in a decade, the HVAC division president resigned the day of the miss, management has admitted poor agility on tariffs and copper, and the equity story depends on a RMB35bn financial-asset pile a third of which is deposited with the controlling shareholder's finance company -- a governance risk the price is already discounting. Bull cut to 20% because it requires several independent things (China demand floor, overseas margin recovery, JV stability, Sanden conversion) to go right simultaneously. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.
